stages.name: Concept
stages.purpose: Fix the promise, the platform and the look before any production cost is committed.

outputs.title: string
outputs.logline: string <=35 words: protagonist + goal + obstacle + stakes
outputs.hook: string: one image or line readable in 3 panels
outputs.theme: string: a question, not a moral

stages.aiInstruction: develop the concept; return JSON only

stages.name: Story bible
stages.purpose: Build the rule system, the location strings and the character reference memory every later stage depends on.

cast.name: string
cast.faceAnchor: string 20-35 words, permanent identity only: face shape, eyes, brows, hair silhouette, build, marks. NO clothing, NO mood
cast.versions: [{ type: base|variant|evolution, name, slug, inheritsFrom, description, identityMarkers: string[2-5], sheets: {portrait, fullBody, turnaround, expressions, poses}, approved }]

outputs.referenceMemory: per character: one base version minimum; portrait + fullBody attached before the character is renderable; variants/evolutions never overwrite base

gate: every character has a face anchor with no clothing in it
every character has a base version
portrait + full body sheet attached before that character is rendered
stages.aiInstruction: build world OR cast; return JSON only

stages.name: Beat sheet
stages.purpose: Pace the episode in scroll units, each ending with a reason to continue.
stages.aiInstruction: write one episode beat sheet; return JSON only

stages.name: Panels
stages.purpose: Decide what the reader sees, from where, at what size and in what order.

outputs.versions: Record<characterId, versionId> — omit for base design
outputs.outfits: Record<characterId, string> — per-panel wardrobe override, never a face change

stages.aiInstruction: break the beat sheet into panels; return JSON only

stages.name: Prompts
stages.purpose: Compile deterministic render briefs so 45 panels look like one artist.
stages.aiInstruction: compile only; do not rewrite the story

stages.name: Render
stages.purpose: Produce art per panel conditioned on the character reference sheets, or a deliberate storyboard cut with identical framing.

outputs.attachedReferences: string[] (portrait/full body/turnaround of every version bound to the panel, max 4)
outputs.measuredQA: per panel: intrinsic size, aspect vs plan, mean luma, contrast, dead-border flag, 120px edge energy

gate: every recurring character in the panel has a portrait + full body reference
bound version sheets attached as image inputs where the provider supports it
no panel is narrower than the canvas, flat, or dead-bordered
stages.aiInstruction: image generation only; never letter text inside the image

stages.name: Lettering
stages.purpose: Make the page readable in the correct order, at phone size.
stages.aiInstruction: place and typeset; do not write new dialogue unless asked

stages.name: QC & export
stages.purpose: Catch objective errors, then ship the pack.

outputs.uploadSections: { width, maxSectionHeight, sections[{filename, from, to, panels}] } validated against the platform's file/bytes/image caps
outputs.uploadPlan: markdown manifest: section table, strip geometry, warnings

gate: section count and file sizes fit the platform caps
stages.aiInstruction: audit and report with specific fixes
